question: Solve ((6.9)³+(2.7)³+(5.8)³-3×6.9×2.7×5.8)/((6.9)²+(2.7)²+(5.8)²-(6.9)(2.7)-(2.7)(5.8)-(5.8)(6.9))
solution:
**Concept Used:**

a³ + b³ + c³ – 3abc = (a + b + c)(a² + b² + c² – ab – bc – ca)

**Calculation:**

⇒ ((6.9)³+(2.7)³+(5.8)³-3×6.9×2.7×5.8)/((6.9)²+(2.7)²+(5.8)²-(6.9)(2.7)-(2.7)(5.8)-(5.8)(6.9))

Applying the formula,

⇒ ((6.9+2.7+5.8)(6.9²+2.7²+5.8²-6.9times 2.7-2.7times 5.8-5.8times 6.9))/(6.9²+2.7²+5.8²-6.9times 2.7-2.7times 5.8-5.8times 6.9)

Cancelling the terms, we get

⇒ 6.9 + 2.7 + 5.8 = 15.4

**Hence, the simplified value of the expression is 15.4**
